p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old=s[s.index('# Some providers'):s.index('    return hook.event_id\n')+len('    return hook.event_id\n')]
new='''# Northwind keys are truncated to a short prefix (PAY-333). Kept as-is so
# existing northwind replay behaviour does not change.
SHORT_KEY_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"northwind"})
_KEY_PREFIX = 8


def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # The Idempotency-Key header is the replay identity. Providers are not
    # consistent about the body event id on retry (e.g. harbor sends
    # po_1844 then po_1844.2), so the event id is only a fallback for
    # deliveries without the header.
    if hook.idempotency_key:
        if hook.provider in SHORT_KEY_PROVIDERS:
            return hook.idempotency_key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
        return hook.idempotency_key
    return hook.event_id
'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_distinct_harbor_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "8f3c1a9eaaaaaaaa", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 2
EOF
